checkpoints.note: After earlier space-delimited tokens, `lex_config()` reaches the final delimiter at copied offset 24944, skips it as whitespace, then sees `'V'` at offset 24945. Because that byte is not `$` and still satisfies `isstring(chr)`, control enters `lex_string()` for the last token that runs to EOF.

First non-harness parser state initialization that materializes the copied fuzz buffer and its extent into lexer state. For the saved witness, `pos` and `start` begin at `static_data` and `end` becomes `static_data + 32768`, the one-past-array address that later feeds the EOF/backup bug.
The fix changes this exact call to `config_init_data(config, data, len - 1)`, reserving one byte inside `static_data` for the EOF/backup path instead of letting `end` land just past the array.
